meta.title: Synthetic Biophilia - Image Gallery
meta.description: Explore the visual documentation of phyllotactic patterns and lattice structures

images.title: Lattice Study #01 - Side View
images.caption: Phyllotactic lattice structure exploring 169° golden angle rotation. This side view demonstrates the emergent spiral patterns that arise from simple geometric rules applied iteratively.

images.title: Lattice Study #02 - Top View
images.caption: Top-down perspective of the same 169° lattice structure, revealing radial symmetry and self-organizing patterns characteristic of phyllotaxis in nature.

images.title: Bush-Like Leaf Formation
images.caption: Organic clustering pattern generated through iterative spiral growth algorithms. The overlapping forms mimic the dense foliage arrangement found in natural shrubs.

images.title: Closed Lattice - Side View
images.caption: Side perspective of closed lattice structure showing the relationship between individual cells and overall geometric form.

images.title: Closed Lattice - Top View
images.caption: Top-down view of closed lattice formation revealing internal structural patterns and void distributions.

images.title: Circular Leaf Formation - Side
images.caption: Side view of circular arrangement demonstrating leaf-like organic forms emerging from mathematical spiral patterns.

images.title: Tree-Like Structure - Low Density
images.caption: Tall, low-density configuration exploring vertical growth patterns and spacing relationships in bio-inspired structures.

images.title: Dome Structure - Underneath View #1
images.caption: Underside perspective of dome lattice structure showing node connections and structural integrity from interior viewpoint.

images.title: Dome Structure - Underneath View #2
images.caption: Alternative angle of dome interior revealing the complexity and beauty of phyllotactic packing in three-dimensional space.

images.title: Joint Connection Detail
images.caption: Close-up study of lattice joint connections showing how individual elements interconnect to form stable structural networks.

images.title: Lattice Joint Assembly
images.caption: Detailed view of lattice joint assembly demonstrating the precision of node placement and connection geometry.
